title: Coverage recovery Wave 02 part 2 — Keplr, Petra, GridPlus, Core, UniSat
notes: Candidate event/evidence IDs are provisional. Product launch/support fields remain unchanged unless the evidence supports a bounded reviewed promotion from fresh main.

events.title: Keplr extension update added Ledger signing support
events.description: Chainapsis announced a new Keplr extension version adding Ledger hardware-wallet signing support, directly documenting active extension maintenance in September 2020.

events.title: Lattice1 firmware v0.18.3 released
events.description: GridPlus released Lattice1 firmware v0.18.3 with Solana signing improvements, security improvements, bug fixes, and user-requested changes.

events.title: Core browser extension released
events.description: Ava Labs announced the release of Core as a non-custodial browser extension for Avalanche and made the extension available through the Chrome Web Store.

evidence.title: How to use Ledger Nano hardware wallet with Keplr
evidence.notes: First-party Chainapsis post stating that a new Keplr extension version was released with Ledger signing support. This proves active maintenance by 2020-09-07 but is not treated as the original launch date.

evidence.title: Aptos Labs Wallet Terms of Use
evidence.notes: Current first-party terms explicitly identify the downloadable self-custodial Petra wallet application and browser extension as services made available by Aptos Labs. Supports current product existence/support evidence without inferring an original launch date.

evidence.title: Lattice1 Firmware v0.18.3 Released
evidence.notes: First-party firmware release announcement documenting ongoing Lattice1 maintenance.

evidence.title: What is the Core extension?
evidence.notes: Current first-party support documentation states that Core is a non-custodial browser extension and that the extension is officially supported on Chrome.

evidence.title: UniSat Wallet official repositories
evidence.notes: The official UniSat Wallet GitHub organization identifies the active wallet monorepo as the official repository for browser extension, mobile apps, and shared wallet infrastructure. The older extension repository is marked deprecated and migrated.

evidence.title: Ava Labs Releases Core, an All-In-One Web3 Command Center for Avalanche
evidence.notes: First-party launch announcement explicitly stating that Ava Labs released Core and that the browser extension was available from the Chrome Web Store on 2022-06-22.
